verdict.rationale: Cubic's docs describe a 'Fix with cubic' button on review findings and one-click targeted fixes. They also cover auto-fix across every review of a PR and replying to or tagging @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments to fix issues, with cubic generating the fix and pushing it to the PR branch. Threads can auto-resolve once the issue is fixed, so the whole finding-to-committed-patch loop stays inside the PR. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-PR fix and push flow works as documented.
